description: C++23 campaign runtime and SDL3/Vulkan client with durable Player17 saves, native research, fleet navigation, shipyard, construction and observer-safe orbital workspaces. Known planetary images, orbital geometry and mouse navigation are native. Canonical simulation rules and sovereign currencies remain authoritative. No Godot or .NET runtime is required. Full system graphics, local fleet presentation, colony/diplomacy screens and audio remain under development. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
